newsitem.title: USA: Mobil to market petrol supply, trading data.
newsitem.headline: Mobil to market petrol supply, trading data.

text.p: Mobil Corp and TIBCO Inc, an independent division of Reuters Holdings Plc, said on Monday the two companies would jointly market the TIBENERGY Global Supply and Trading System.
TIBENERGY is a fully integrated, real-time system for managing the trading of crude oil and petroleum products, the companies said in a joint statement.
The companies said the system would provide access to information on profit/loss projections, price risk exposure and projected daily inventory.
The two companies said they formed a partnership in 1993 to develop a supply and trading management system for Mobil's traders, which resulted in the TIBENERGY system.
